snippet.title: Taqatwar Kaun Hai? | Asal Taqat Ghusse Par Qaabu | Bukhari 6114 #shorts
snippet.description:
Taqatwar woh nahin jo kushti mein doosron ko gira de, balkay taqatwar woh hai jo ghusse ke waqt khud ko qaabu mein rakhe.

Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Hurairah Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ»

References
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6114: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6114
• Sahih Muslim 2609: https://sunnah.com/muslim:2609

Yeh video us ko bhejein jise aaj yeh sunne ki zaroorat hai. One more sadqah 🤍
